name: Add Bootstrap and Tailwind Css
author: Habib Ali

sections.description:
Key Features:

  • Easy Activation: Simply install and activate the plugin to start using Bootstrap and Tailwind CSS in your WordPress site.
  • Universal Compatibility: Works across various Bootstrap and Tailwind CSS versions, ensuring compatibility with your existing projects.
  • Flexible Integration: Easily add Bootstrap classes to your divs and containers, enhancing your site’s styling capabilities.
  • No Coding Required: Eliminate the need for manual coding of CSS classes, saving time and reducing errors.

How It Works:

  1. Install and Activate: Install the plugin through the WordPress admin panel and activate it.
  2. Use Bootstrap Classes: Apply Bootstrap classes directly to your HTML elements within your WordPress content.
  3. Utilize Tailwind CSS: Incorporate Tailwind CSS utility classes into your WordPress theme or custom post types.
  4. Customization Options: While not required, you can customize the plugin settings to fine-tune its behavior if needed.

Enhance your WordPress site’s design capabilities with Bootstrap and Tailwind CSS Integrator – a straightforward solution for incorporating these powerful front-end frameworks into your web development workflow.

Short Description

Easily integrate Bootstrap and Tailwind CSS into your WordPress site.
